name: SentencePiece model deserialization and tokenization
description:
LoadFromSerializedProto deserializes an untrusted, attacker-controlled byte blob as a protobuf ModelProto and then builds the full tokenizer state from it (vocabulary trie, normalizer precompiled-charsmap trie, special-token ids, and a self-test run that already exercises Encode on embedded self_test_data samples). Because the blob directly drives vocabulary parsing, trie construction (Darts double array) and normalizer charsmap decoding, a malformed/malicious serialized model is a prime target for memory-safety and logic bugs (e.g. oversized/overlapping pieces, bad trie arrays, misaligned precompiled_charsmap, NaN/Inf scores, unknown model_type).
- LoadFromSerializedProto: target; parses the raw bytes into a ModelProto (ParseFromArray) and calls Load(unique_ptr<ModelProto>), reaching all of core.
- Load(const ModelProto&) / Load(std::unique_ptr<ModelProto>): variants/sources — alternate ways to hand a (possibly fuzzer-built) ModelProto object into the same core; Load(unique_ptr) is the common sink all loaders funnel into and is where ModelFactory::Create, Normalizer construction and the self-test loop run.
- Load(absl::string_view filename): variant/source — loads the same serialized-proto bytes from a file via io::LoadModelProto instead of memory, reaching the same core.
- SetEncodeExtraOptions / SetDecodeExtraOptions: configuration — parse "bos:eos:reverse:unk"-style strings (ParseExtraOptions) that toggle ApplyExtraOptions behavior used by Encode/Decode consumers; they require a successfully loaded model (status() check) so must follow LoadFromSerializedProto.
- Encode(input, pieces/ids) and NBestEncode/SampleEncode: consumers — run model_->Encode()/NBestEncode()/SampleEncode(), which dispatch to the model-specific core (unigram Viterbi lattice PopulateNodes/EncodeOptimized, BPE symbol merge, word/char splitting) chosen at load time by TrainerSpec.model_type(), and also exercise normalizer_->Normalize() on the loaded precompiled_charsmap trie.
- Decode(pieces or ids, detokenized): consumer — walks the loaded piece table (IdToPiece/PieceToId/IsByte/IsControl/IsUnknown) built during Load, exercising the vocabulary data structures from the opposite direction.
- Input space to fuzz: the raw serialized ModelProto bytes themselves are the primary fuzz surface — particularly trainer_spec.model_type() (UNIGRAM/BPE/WORD/CHAR, each selecting a different ModelInterface subclass and thus a different core path in ModelFactory::Create), the pieces() list (piece text/length up to and beyond kMaxPieceSize=8000, score NaN/Inf, piece type NORMAL/USER_DEFINED/UNUSED/CONTROL/UNKNOWN/BYTE), normalizer_spec.precompiled_charsmap (empty vs present, well-formed vs corrupted Darts double-array blob, alignment), denormalizer_spec presence, and self_test_data.samples (which get auto-run through Encode during Load, already exercising the encode core). Secondary surface: the extra_option strings passed to SetEncodeExtraOptions/SetDecodeExtraOptions ("bos","eos","reverse","unk"/"unk_piece") and the text/ids given to Encode/Decode after loading.
This list is incomplete; what the project's own fuzzers and tests do with the target stays.
